description: Rewrite lib/features/home/providers/banners_provider.dart to store/read banners as a JSON array inside the already-cached platform_settings table (single row key='home_banners'), removing every .from('banners'). Also update the campaign list providers (home_provider.dart and campaigns_provider.dart) to EXCLUDE job rows (is_job) so the real Campaigns/Home screens never show job rows, and revert the DBG3 passthrough in error_utils.dart. Depends on FEAT-001 (platform_settings is already cached, no schema change needed for banners, but campaigns.is_job must exist for the exclusion filters). Independent of FEAT-002 code-wise but shares the same is_job contract.
steps: banners_provider.dart: add `import 'dart:convert';`. Define a private constant key `_bannersKey = 'home_banners'` and a helper that reads the platform_settings row: SupabaseService.client.from('platform_settings').select('value').eq('key', _bannersKey).maybeSingle(); if null or value null/empty, return <Map<String,dynamic>>[]. Otherwise jsonDecode the 'value' string into a List and cast each element to Map<String,dynamic>. Guard with try/catch returning [] on parse errors.

Define a private helper writeBanners(List<Map<String,dynamic>> list) that jsonEncodes the list and UPSERTS the platform_settings row: SupabaseService.client.from('platform_settings').upsert({'key': _bannersKey, 'value': jsonEncode(list), 'updated_at': now}, onConflict: 'key'). (platform_settings.key is UNIQUE so onConflict:'key' works.)

bannersProvider (home carousel): read all banners via the helper, keep only those with is_visible == true, sort by sort_order ascending, return the list. Preserve the try/catch that returns [] on any error and the FutureProvider<List<Map<String,dynamic>>> type.
adminBannersProvider: read all banners via the helper, sort by sort_order ascending, return all (including hidden). Preserve return type.

Each banner object stored MUST carry an 'id' (generated) so update/delete/toggle can target it, plus keys title, image_url, link_type, link_campaign_id, link_page, is_visible, sort_order, created_at, updated_at. The manage_banners_screen edit form reads e['id'], e['title'], e['image_url'], e['link_type'], e['link_campaign_id'], e['link_page'], e['is_visible']; the list reads b['image_url'], b['title'], b['is_visible'], b['link_type'], b['id']. Keep all of those present.

BannersActionsNotifier.createBanner(data): read current list; generate a new id (use a uuid-like value - e.g. DateTime.now().microsecondsSinceEpoch.toString(), or reuse an existing uuid utility if the repo already has one; a stable unique string is sufficient); compute sort_order = (max existing sort_order)+1 if data doesn't specify it; append {...data, id, is_visible: data['is_visible'] ?? true, sort_order, created_at: now, updated_at: now}; writeBanners; invalidate adminBannersProvider + bannersProvider; return bool. Keep the created_by concept only if it fits the JSON (optional).

updateBanner(id, data): read list; find the entry with matching 'id'; merge {...existing, ...data, 'updated_at': now, 'id': id}; write back the full list; invalidate both providers; return bool. If no match, return false.
toggleVisibility(id, current): call updateBanner(id, {'is_visible': !current}). Keep signature.
deleteBanner(id): read list; remove the entry whose 'id' == id; writeBanners; invalidate both; return bool. Keep signature.
Keep bannersActionsProvider (StateNotifierProvider<BannersActionsNotifier, AsyncValue<void>>) and BannersActionsNotifier class name unchanged. Ensure no remaining .from('banners').

home_provider.dart: add job exclusion to the three campaign queries. In featuredCampaignsProvider, filteredCampaignsProvider, and recentCampaignsProvider, add `.eq('is_job', false)` (or `.not('is_job','is',true)` if you prefer null-safety, but since FEAT-001 sets is_job NOT NULL DEFAULT false, `.eq('is_job', false)` is correct and simplest) to each campaigns query so job rows never appear on Home. Do not change the trendingCreatorsProvider or user-profile providers.

campaigns_provider.dart: add `.eq('is_job', false)` to campaignsListProvider (campaigns query) and campaignDetailProvider (campaigns query) so job rows never appear on the Campaigns screen or its detail. Do NOT filter the applications-based providers (myApplicationsProvider/appliedCampaignsProvider) by is_job directly; instead rely on the campaign join - but to be safe, the applications used there are campaign applications (status pending/approved/rejected), and their joined campaigns will have is_job=false; still, since those queries embed campaigns(...), add the is_job filter only on the campaigns tables queried directly (campaignsListProvider, campaignDetailProvider). Leave application queries as-is.

error_utils.dart: REVERT the DBG3 temporary passthrough. Remove the TEMP DEBUG comment block and the line `return 'DBG3: ${error.toString()}';` and the `// ignore: dead_code` line, so that after computing `final message = error.toString().toLowerCase();` the function proceeds directly into the normal branch chain (network, auth, permission, recursion, not-found -> 'The requested data was not found.', etc.). Do not change any other branch text.
acceptance_criteria: grep for .from('banners') across lib/ returns ZERO matches.

banners_provider.dart reads/writes banners via platform_settings key 'home_banners' as a JSON array, and still exports bannersProvider, adminBannersProvider, bannersActionsProvider, BannersActionsNotifier with unchanged names/types and methods createBanner/updateBanner/toggleVisibility/deleteBanner.
Stored banner objects include an 'id' plus title, image_url, link_type, link_campaign_id, link_page, is_visible, sort_order so manage_banners_screen and the home carousel keep working.
home_provider.dart featured/filtered/recent campaign queries and campaigns_provider.dart list/detail campaign queries all exclude is_job rows.
error_utils.dart sanitize() no longer returns any 'DBG3' string; the not-found branch returns 'The requested data was not found.' and the normal branch chain executes.
Braces/parentheses balance in all changed files.
verification: grep -n "DBG3" lib/core/utils/error_utils.dart returns nothing; grep -n "The requested data was not found" returns the not-found branch.
grep -n "is_job" lib/features/home/providers/home_provider.dart and lib/features/campaigns/providers/campaigns_provider.dart show the exclusion filters on campaign queries.
Brace/paren balance check on banners_provider.dart, home_provider.dart, campaigns_provider.dart, error_utils.dart.
